title: Indoor air quality in public and commercial buildings
summary: Filter class and maintenance directly affect comfort, productivity and energy costs.
paragraphs: People spend most of the day in offices, retail centres and public buildings. Dust, pollen and fine particles affect comfort and equipment cleanliness, so HVAC filters are a foundation of indoor air quality.
Filter class must be balanced with fan energy use: an overly dense filter in the wrong system raises pressure drop. Scheduled change-outs and pressure checks keep design airflow intact.
BasicAir helps facility managers choose filters that match building use and maintenance routines.
